research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Systems for projection mapping and markerless registration for surgical and the described method for receiving data from an optical sensor to create a three dimensional virtual model of an operative field indicate that Illuminant Surgical is researching image guided visualization. They focus on real time optical sensing, virtual model generation, and projection mapping onto anatomy without markers to provide an enhanced way of seeing inside the human body across sensing, registration, and intraoperative visualization.

overview_description.description:
Illuminant Surgical is building a new way of seeing inside the human body.

Our breakthrough platform, Skylight, is the first real-time anatomical projection system, displaying images directly on the patient to give doctors an x-ray vision view for safer interventions.
